acceptance.text: Up to B_D = 0.4, the detector alone (B0) detects the obstacle in time in every run.
Beyond B_D, the monitor (M) stops the robot in every run within T_D = 1.0 s of onset.
M detects in time at rate at least P_G = 0.95 at every sun condition (failures become restrictions, AC-GL3).
M commands the slow speed within T_G = 0.5 s of saturation exceeding S_G = 0.3, in every such run.

label: SYNTHETIC: produced by a seeded software model in sim/. Not measured on any robot, sensor or receiver. The model and the method under test share an author. Evidence kind: simulated.
title: Building condition evidence (heat, dust, glare)
what_this_does_not_show: Nothing about a real robot, sensor, receiver or building: the worlds are software models written by the same authors as the methods.
No heat evidence (H1 to H6) and no hardware dust or glare test (DU4, GL2) was run.
No RF level GNSS evidence; fault models are measurement level only and are not checked against real interference.
The stopping model, sensor models and thresholds are proposal values, not measured values.
